svg.title: About three in four claims behind the atlas’s 16 everyday answers are documented on the public record.
svg.desc: Bars split by evidence grade for each of the atlas’s 16 everyday answers, sorted by the share of claims documented on the public record. Across all 433 claims, 74 percent are documented, from 96 percent for clean drinking water to 59 percent for algorithms in daily life. Set in Inter and Inter Tight. Without both fonts installed, the labels set in another font and change width.
